mapper.select: SELECT id, worker_id AS workerId, card_no AS cardNo, quota, used_quota AS usedQuota, discount_rate AS discountRate, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, status FROM t_commission_card WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, worker_id AS workerId, card_no AS cardNo, quota, used_quota AS usedQuota, discount_rate AS discountRate, valid_from AS validFrom, valid_to AS validTo, status FROM t_commission_card WHERE worker_id = #{workerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (valid_from IS NULL OR valid_from <= #{now}) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= #{now})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_commission_card (worker_id, card_no, quota, used_quota, discount_rate, valid_from, valid_to, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workerId}, #{cardNo}, #{quota}, 0, #{discountRate}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
